_why: The spoken script of meridian-reel.mp4, which existed nowhere. The voice-over mp3 is gitignored and the sandbox that held it is gone, so when Otis asked to change the closing line on 18 Sep 2026 the words had to be recovered by transcribing the finished render. Recording them here means that never has to happen again. Timings are from that transcript and are what rebuild-reel-audio.py places each line at, so narration stays locked to the picture.

voice.note: Brian (ElevenLabs, nPczCjzI2devNBz1zQrb via vidIQ) read the original. He was unavailable when this was rebuilt - vidIQ was 6 credits short - so every line was re-read by Sterling. That is why the whole film sounds like a different man, not just the closing line.

measured._why: File lengths of real readings of the new line, so nobody re-estimates it. These include whatever silence the generator padded on, so treat them as an upper bound; rebuild-reel-audio.py measures the real files and warns if one overruns.

raw_durations_sterling._why: File lengths as generated, including the silence the generator pads on. rebuild-reel-audio.py trims that off before placing, so the real speech is shorter. Kept so nobody has to re-measure.

timing_note: Sterling reads slower than Brian, so the start times above are not the original ones. Total speech is close to the length of the film: the padding MUST be trimmed or the lines collide. rebuild-reel-audio.py trims and then reports every line against its slot - trust its output over these numbers.
